episodes.synopsis: Bit Cloud is out looking for Zoid parts when a battle begins around him. Can he convience either the Blitz Team or the Saber Fang squad to let him join their squad, or will he be stuck as a scavenger forever?
episodes.title: Commence Battle: Attack Liger Zero

episodes.synopsis: When Bit goes into a long range battle without a decent long range weapon, it's up to him and Liger to get up by ""The Red Comet"" in her type of fight. Can they make it close range when Naomi has never been in close range before?
episodes.title: New Partners vs Naomi; The Red Comet

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious man ambushes the Blitz Team and tries to get Lena to share his love. The man is a rich man by the name Harry Champ, and he wants to marry Lena, but first he must defeat Bit. Can this millionaire succeed?
episodes.title: The Prince Arrives: Harry Champ

episodes.synopsis: When the unknown Backdraft Group captures Lena and forces the Blitz team into an unsanctioned battle, it's up to Bit to save the day. Can Liger Zero claim another victory?
episodes.title: Unsanctioned Battle: The Mysterious Backdraft Group

episodes.synopsis: When the Champ Team hires Jack Cisco to defeat the Blitz Team, it's up to Bit to unlock the Liger's first transformation unit. Will they succeed, or will the Lightning Siax just have to much speed to be defeated?
episodes.title: High Speed Battle: Transforming Into Zero Jager

episodes.synopsis: The Back Draft Group decides to once again attack the Blitz Team with a new unknown zoid: The Elephandor, but what exactly is the Ultimate X zoid that the Back Draft group is looking for?
episodes.title: The Dark Giant: The Invincible Elephander

episodes.synopsis: When the Blitz team and Fluggel teams get ambushed in the desert, it's up to Lenna and her new Gunsniper to save the day. Will they succeed?
episodes.title: The Desert Gang: The Hover Cargo's in Danger

episodes.synopsis: An unknown man named Dr. Layon decides to help the Tigers team get on the winning track again, but at what costs, and why does he want to destroy Lenna's dad?
episodes.title: Invasion of the Fierce Tigers: Transform to Zero Schneider

episodes.synopsis: Harry's sister Mary decides to come and make him grow up until she sees the Liger Zero. Now she wants to win the Liger Zero for herself, but can she actually defeat the Blitz team when no one else has?
episodes.title: The Princess Arrives: Mary Champ

episodes.synopsis: Altail decides to have the Back Draft group try one final test on Liger Zero to prove its the Ultimate X. Can Bit and Liger survive?
episodes.title: Desert Tusk: Assault of the War Sharks

episodes.synopsis: Jack Cisco forms a team composed of nothing but Lightning Siax to do battle with the Blitz Team. Can Bit and company have any hope of winning when they only have one fast Zoid?
episodes.title: The Sensational Three: Rematch with Jack Cisco

episodes.synopsis: Liger Zero is stolen by Altail and the Back Draft group to do a one-on-one battle with the Elephandor. Can Bit and Liger survive when all their safeties have been removed?
episodes.title: Zero Is Stolen: The Fiery Battle

episodes.synopsis: The Zoid battle comission allows the Blitz Team to do battle with the Back Draft Group in an approved match up, but will the Blitz Team stand a chance when Jamie is their only air pilot, and he can't even control the Raynos he now has?
episodes.title: The Brave Wild Eagle: The Raynos vs. the Zabats

episodes.synopsis: Lenna gets challenged by the "Chainsaw" man in this classic Halloween spoof. Does she stand any chance against the mysterious Zoid that cuts everything up, or will her teammates even stand by her?
episodes.title: Fright Day The 13th

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Layon decides to get revenge on Dr. Toros by kidnapping Lenna and forcing the Blitz Team into a gravity free battle. Can Liger Zero and the Command Wolf defeat Layon when they can't get a firm grip on the ground?
episodes.title: Layon Returns: Anti-Gravity Catastrophe!

episodes.synopsis: When the Back Draft group overwhelms Naomi, she gets help from an unlikely source. The two form a team together and challenge the Blitz Team. Can Bit and company have any chance against this new "unknown" rival?
episodes.title: Red Rival: Leon Toros Returns!

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Layon joins the Back draft group to strengthen his abilities to get revenge on Toros. Can he actually finally win an illegal battle against the Blitz Team?
episodes.title: Warriors On Vacation: The Storm Sworders

episodes.synopsis: Benjamin has fallen in love with a judge that has the same operating frequency as him. And with Harry & Bit's help he might see her again.
episodes.title: Love on the Battlefield: My Love, the Judge

episodes.synopsis: Stoller has left the Back Draft group and become a legintimate Zi fighter, but will he stand a chance when the Back Draft Group decides to retaliate? Perhaps, with a little help from Bit.
episodes.title: The Third Conversion: Zero Panzer's Debut!

episodes.synopsis: Brad goes looking for a mysterious new Zoid, but will his temptation to gain the Zoid cause him to leave and attack the Blitz Team?
episodes.title: The Shadow Fox: Brad's Betrayal

episodes.synopsis: When Lenna finally accepts a date from Harry, Dr. Layon decides they must be lovers and kidnaps Harry. Will Lenna be able to go at full strength during the next battle knowing that Layon has Harry?
episodes.title: Harry's Disaster: Dr. Laon Traps Toros!

episodes.synopsis: The Back Draft group decides to search for another Ultimate X. Can Bit and Harry stop them from succeeding?
episodes.title: The Dragon Under the Sea: In Search of the Ultimate X

episodes.synopsis: On a day of recreation, Blitz and Jack are humiliated by a kid named Vega. The next day, they are attacked by a new Zoid piloted by the same kid. Why is he attacking them?
episodes.title: The Dragon Awakens: The Berserk Fury Enters the Fray

episodes.synopsis: All Class A teams are put into the Royal Cup competition. The winner gets admitted into Class S, but the only Zoids that can be used are what you carry on hand. There can be no repairs once a Zoid is defeated. Can the Blitz Team find a way to win with only 4 Zoids, 3 transformations, and at least 5 battle wins needed?
episodes.title: Tournament of Heroes: The Royal Cup

episodes.synopsis: It all comes down to this. The Blitz team wins all 5 of their matches to advance to the final, but Team Vega also gets 5 wins. Which one will end up being the Ultimate champion?
episodes.title: Survival: The Mystery of the Ultimate X

episodes.synopsis: Everyone except for the Blitz Team and the Vega team have suffered losses, so it comesdown to the two of them. Which Ultimate X will end up being the victor?
episodes.title: The Miracle of Zero - The Wind, the Cloud and Adventure
